metadata.title: Rolling woodland course study
metadata.description: Procedural, synthetic course-inspired terrain with softly undulating ground, irregular oak and eucalyptus groves, scattered specimens, shrubs and three subtle sandy hollows. No flags, hole layout or measured real-course geometry.
metadata.coordinateSystem: x transverse in metres, y up in metres, z forward in metres; z repeats every 240 metres

types.3: varied tree canopies and shrub clumps

metadata.loopNote: Terrain, route and terrain derivatives repeat every 240 m. All crown and branch points wrap in z; render modular z distance or neighbor copies for seamless motion.
